data.current_summary: Buy standing access with an x402 or MPP payment
data.current_description: Pay a whole number of US dollars to receive a Brandfetch organization, an API key holding 20 prepaid API credits per dollar, and an MCP bearer token. One credit is one Brand API, Brand Context API or Transaction API request. Call once without a payment to receive the 402: its `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header is the x402 challenge (USDC on Base), its `WWW-Authenticate` header the MPP challenges (USDC.e on Tempo, or a card through a Stripe shared payment token). Pay one and repeat the request with the result — `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` for x402, `Authorization: Payment …` for MPP. A wallet owns the organization it buys: paying again from the same wallet adds credits to the same key, and `rotateKey=true` replaces the key while doing so. A card names no wallet, so each card payment buys its own organization and key. The API key and MCP token are returned once, in the response that completes the purchase, and a payment is never charged twice. A later request carrying the same payment is answered `409` without them: a settled payment is public (an x402 signature is on-chain), so presenting it proves nothing about who sent it. If the purchase is answered with a `500` that says to retry, or with no response at all, retry the exact request at once: the first retry to succeed within three minutes of the payment receives the credential, unless it was already returned in a response the client lost, which is answered `409` `credential_already_delivered`. The credits are granted whether or not the credential is returned. See https://docs.brandfetch.com/agents/overview.

Returns an organization, API key preloaded with 20 credits per dollar paid, and MCP bearer token. Repeated payments from the same wallet add credits to the existing key (or replace it if rotateKey=true). Card payments create separate organizations. Credentials are returned only once; duplicate payments receive 409 responses. If a 500 error occurs, retry the exact request within three minutes.

data.current_summary: Buy standing access with an x402 or MPP payment
data.current_description: Pay a whole number of US dollars to receive a Brandfetch organization, an API key holding 20 prepaid API credits per dollar, and an MCP bearer token. One credit is one Brand API, Brand Context API or Transaction API request. Call once without a payment to receive the 402: its `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header is the x402 challenge (USDC on Base), its `WWW-Authenticate` header the MPP challenges (USDC.e on Tempo, or a card through a Stripe shared payment token). Pay one and repeat the request with the result — `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` for x402, `Authorization: Payment …` for MPP. A wallet owns the organization it buys: paying again from the same wallet adds credits to the same key, and `rotateKey=true` replaces the key while doing so. A card names no wallet, so each card payment buys its own organization and key. The API key and MCP token are returned once, in the response that completes the purchase, and a payment is never charged twice. A later request carrying the same payment is answered `409` without them: a settled payment is public (an x402 signature is on-chain), so presenting it proves nothing about who sent it. If the purchase is answered with a `500` that says to retry, or with no response at all, retry the exact request at once: the first retry to succeed within three minutes of the payment receives the credential, unless it was already returned in a response the client lost, which is answered `409` `credential_already_delivered`. The credits are granted whether or not the credential is returned. See https://docs.brandfetch.com/agents/overview.

Two-step process: (1) Call without payment to receive the 402 challenge with payment options in `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` and `WWW-Authenticate` headers. (2) Complete payment and repeat request with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (x402) or `Authorization: Payment …` (MPP) header. Wallet-based payments add credits to existing keys; card payments create new organizations. Credentials are returned only once; duplicate payments return 409.
